To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) we propose an efficient architecture, PeleeNet, with conventional convolution, which achieves higher accuracy than MobileNet and lower computational cost; 2) we combine PeleeNet and SSD and optimize the architecture to achieve a real-time object detector on mobile devices, named Pelee; 3) we port SSD to the iOS platform and provide an optimized implementation of SSD; 4) Pelee outperforms TinyYOLOv3 on both accuracy and computational cost.

(ii) We propose a fast real-time object detection framework on iOS, which achieves 70.7% mAP on VOC2007 dataset with 17 FPS on an iPhone 6s.
